messages:
maria: heads up — large spike of Pending pods in us-west-2 gpu nodepool, reason 'AttachVolume timed out' and 'failed to attach network interface'. ~120 pending, >70 showing Allocated GPUs but not bound. anyone seeing this?
infra-bot: [alert] 2026-03-18T09:07:12Z cluster:us-west-2 autoscaler: scaling activity detected (increase request)
k8s-autoscaler-bot: recommending scale up: +12 nodes in gpu-pool-usw2-a (policy: opportunistic-burst)
jake: ack, I'm seeing ENI attach failures in the control-plane logs. ENI quota in the subnet is at 98%. could be CNI/IP exhaustion.
sophie: copying logs:
```
May 18 09:06:45 kubelet[1234]: error attaching ENI: createNetworkInterface: RequestLimitExceeded: Rate exceeded
May 18 09:06:46 kubelet[1234]: pod "batch-job-52-abc" is Pending: failed to attach network interface
```
leo: also seeing a bunch of identical cron-triggered batch jobs launching in parallel — looks like a backoff/retry bug in the jobs controller for our training orchestrator. they hammer the scheduler when ENI is scarce.
sam: so two issues: ENI/ENI-attach quota + runaway job churn. which is the choke point?
maria: ENI attach errors correlate with pending GPU pods. autoscaler sees unschedulable pods and requests new nodes -> cloud starts provisioning -> new nodes can't attach interfaces fast enough -> pods race to allocate GPUs -> more attach attempts -> throttle. classic feedback loop.
jake: I'm temporarily increasing subnet ENI quota request to cloud support, but that won't help immediately. short-term mitigation: can we pause the orchestrator to stop new job submissions?
sophie: yes, we can flip the feature flag and scale down the job controller deployment to 0. issuing now.
sophie: /kubectl -n batch scale deployment job-orch --replicas=0
infra-bot: deploy job-orch scaled to 0 replicas by sophie at 09:12
leo: pausing helps, pending count drops from 120 -> 48 over 3 minutes. but ~48 remain stuck with 'AttachVolume timed out'.
maria: plan: 1) cordon gpu-pool-usw2-a to stop new scheduling there 2) manually scale up a different gpu pool in us-west-2 with spare ENI quota (gpu-pool-usw2-b) 3) bump cluster-autoscaler max surge for a few minutes 4) set scale-down-delay to 15m to avoid oscillation
sam: agree. someone run the cordon and scale actions?
jake: cordoning gpu-pool-usw2-a now: /kubectl cordon nodepool-gpu-a-node-*/done
infra-bot: nodepool-gpu-a-node-1 cordoned by jake
infra-bot: nodepool-gpu-a-node-2 cordoned by jake
infra-bot: nodepool-gpu-a-node-3 cordoned by jake
jake: scaled up gpu-pool-usw2-b by +8 nodes via infra API (on-demand) — they should land in ~4m.
k8s-autoscaler-bot: temporary max surge increased to +20 nodes for cluster by ops (expires in 15m)
maria: also temporarily patch admission controller to limit parallelism for that orchestrator: maxConcurrentJobs=8
sophie: applied the admission patch. jobs submitted now queue rather than flood.
leo: new nodes started attaching and some pending pods bound -> we have throughput. pending dropped to 12.
jake: cost note: on-demand spin-up will add ~ $2k/hr if maintained; monitor and scale down ASAP once backlog clears.
sam: recommend we also add a fast-fail on ENI attach errors in the job runner to stagger retries (exponential backoff jitter).
maria: agreed for follow-up. immediate tweak: cluster-autoscaler scale-down-delay=15m, scale-up rate limited to 6/min to avoid spiky requests. applied via configmap.
infra-bot: cluster-autoscaler configmap updated by maria at 09:24
leo: backlog cleared to <5, most pods are running. draining nodes in gpu-pool-usw2-a to rebalance.
sophie: re-enabled job-orch at reduced concurrency and new retry logic flag off. monitoring.
leo: rebalancing finished, cordon removed from healthy nodes.
jake: cloud support confirmed ENI quota bump request accepted (provisioning extra 200 ENIs), ETA ~2h for full propagation.
maria: root cause summary (preliminary): subnet ENI attach quota saturation + misbehaving orchestrator that retried aggressively -> created a positive feedback loop with autoscaler. autoscaler exacerbated cost and churn by requesting many nodes while ENI attach failed.
sam: mitigations taken: paused orchestrator, cordoned bad pool, spun up a different pool, admission limit, cluster-autoscaler throttle, temporary config changes.
jake: action items: 1) permanent admission-controller limit for orchestrator (PR ready) 2) job-runner backoff/jitter fix (owner: leo) 3) quota monitoring/alerts for ENI usage (owner: infra) 4) autoscaler policy change: prefer pools with spare NIC capacity (owner: maria)
maria: creating incident follow-up board and runbook task list. we should add a chessboard of fast mitigations for ENI attach storms.
sophie: adding notes to runbook: sample kubectl commands and criteria to cordon vs scale.
infra-bot: incident closed by maria at 10:34 — metrics: peak pending 124, duration ~1h27m. postmortem scheduled tomorrow 11:00 in #incidents.
maria: thanks all. please drop any logs/links in the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
